title: MUniverse Avrillon et al 2024
description: A BIDS-formatted high-density surface EMG (HDsEMG) dataset from 16 young volunteers performing submaximal (10-80% MVC) isometric contractions. Eight participants performed ankle dorsiflexions with recordings from the tibialis anterior, and eight performed knee extensions with recordings from the vastus lateralis. Signals were recorded with four 64-electrode arrays (256 electrodes in total) together with force, to support motor unit identification and the study of rate coding.
methods_description: Surface EMG was recorded with four 2D arrays of 64 electrodes (4 mm spacing for the tibialis anterior, 8 mm for the vastus lateralis) using an EMG-Quattrocento amplifier. Force was recorded with a load cell on an ankle dynamometer or with force sensors on an instrumented chair. Participants performed isometric contractions at 10-80% of maximal voluntary contraction. Electrode coordinates were expressed in a common reference frame based on the first array. The data were converted to BIDS semi-automatically with the MUniverse software.
